note: A poison is a consumable item usable only by rogues whose use spell coats a weapon with Forever's imbue effect 360 and an enchant that casts a spell on hit. Rogue items still on the old temporary enchant effect 54 (Season of Discovery poisons, test items) were not converted for Forever and are left out. Families and ranks come from the item names (a trailing Roman numeral is the rank), checked against the use spell's rank and rising required levels.
